sources.entry: docassemble - System for guided interviews and document assembly, based on Python, YAML, and Markdown. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: docassemble is a system for building guided interviews and assembling documents, written with Python, YAML, and Markdown.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only points to the docassemble web site for a description and installation instructions, and to a Slack group for help. It names no specific features beyond the one-line description: a system for guided interviews and document assembly, based on Python, YAML, and Markdown. The awesome-selfhosted listing places it under 'Polls and Events', lists a demo and source code, and gives Docker and Python as the platforms. Because the README itself gives no detail, specifics about features and capabilities could not be verified from it.
use_cases: automate document generation from user answers
how_to_run: See the docassemble web site for installation instructions
notable: Guided interview and document assembly system
Interviews defined using YAML and Markdown
Help available through a Slack group
caveats: README is minimal; installation and feature details are only on the external web site
Platform support beyond Docker and Python not described in the README
